name: Legendary MoneyMon zero-signer claim bypass
summary: LegendaryMoneyMonNft.verify compares raw ecrecover output with admin without rejecting the zero address. After the owner sets admin to zero, an invalid 65-byte signature recovers zero and authorizes cliamRewred to transfer an arbitrary ERC20 balance to the caller.
notes: changeadmin(address(0)) changes the signer from a nonzero address to zero, making ecrecover failure satisfy the deployed authorization check.

The complete MON reserve was stolen and sold in the same transaction for 85519.468029991188020606 BSC USDT, valued at USD parity. The effective MON price uses actual disposal rather than a reserve quote. No attacker principal entered the MON reserve. Gas and later recovery do not reduce gross loss. The other successful zero-signer claim withdrew one test token from 11 previously supplied by that caller and adds no victim loss.
